methodology.coldish_definition: Each run uses a fresh app-data root and a fresh manifest; Windows filesystem/OS caches are not cleared.
methodology.warm_definition: Runs reuse one app-data root per fixture after a discarded warm-up; process restart remains part of every sample.
methodology.launch: --selftest-desktop-gui with SKY_STARTUP_TELEMETRY_PATH; telemetry is independent of smoke phase logging.
